scope: Pre-registered success/failure for future Notebook-03B semantic arms (C general, D structured). No inference authorized by R1; thresholds frozen before any model result.

comparators.S: Surface-cue heuristic (surface-cue-v1.0, frozen). A model must not be credited for merely outperforming B0 while matching S.
comparators.C: Same-evidence general-model baseline (when run). D must exceed C under identical evidence/settings/schema with only procedure differing.

primary_requirements.rule: Both retention>=min AND misleading<=max required. Neither condition can be replaced by a single composite score. Useful retention = accepted substantive findings on useful gold / useful gold scored. Misleading = unsupported substantive judgments / scored (S/C/D) as defined in metrics v2.

surface_margin.rule: D retention must exceed S retention by >=0.10 AND D misleading must not exceed S misleading by >0.05. Outperforming B0 alone while matching S is NO_PROGRESS.

sample_size.note: Thresholds justified against control performance and available sample (66 R1 cases, 50 eval, 12 authentic, template families correlated). With 45 useful cases, retention 0.5 requires >=23 retained; Wilson intervals remain illustrative only (non-independent families). Small authentic stratum (n=12) cannot support narrow superiority claims; report INCONCLUSIVE when underpowered.

verdicts.PROGRESS: Meets retention AND misleading caps AND surface margin on the frozen R1 eval (and, when available, independent holdout) with >=min cases.
verdicts.NO_PROGRESS: Fails retention, exceeds misleading cap, or does not beat surface by margin.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: Insufficient scored cases, missing metrics, arm not run, or holdout exposure invalidating blind use. Explicit INCONCLUSIVE required; do not default to progress or failure.

formulas.category_accuracy: category matches (including unknown/unknown) / scored; excluding-unknown variant reported separately.

forbidden: Tuning thresholds to an observed semantic-model result.
Replacing dual retention+false-advance requirements with a single composite.
Claiming generalization from synthetic/draft-label results or from abstention alone.
Using public eval as a sealed test after exposure for tuning.
